generate_gmock_classes: run gmock_class.py on a C++ header file to generate Google Mock classes for all classes to stdout
generate_gmock_for_class: run gmock_class.py on a C++ header file with a specific class name to generate only that mock class
generate_gmock_with_indent: run gmock_class.py with the INDENT environment variable set to control output indentation width
review_GenerateMethods: review the _GenerateMethods function that emits MOCK_METHOD macro lines for each virtual method in a C++ class
review_GenerateMocks: review the _GenerateMocks function that iterates AST nodes and builds Mock class definitions with namespace and template support
